messages:
emma: Quick note 1: I'm doing a tiny refresh of the Quickstart: swap to token auth, tighten Docker + Cloud Run examples, and add a short migration callout for existing API keys.

hugo: I can handle the Cloud Run commands and the env var examples. Which runtimes do we want? keep it minimal.

riley: Let's publish node:20 and python:3.11 snippets. Also we should standardize on the new env var name: REDWOOD_TOKEN (replacing REDWOOD_API_KEY).

emma: Exactly. Show both `export REDWOOD_TOKEN=...` and a .env example. Add a one-line migration under Auth showing how to create a token via CLI for demos.

riley: Suggested CLI line: `redwoodctl tokens create --title "quickstart-demo" --format value` then `export REDWOOD_TOKEN=$(...)`. Mark as demo-only.

hugo: Adding a minimal Python Dockerfile for the guide (so tests run consistently):
```
# Dockerfile (python)
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

emma: Nice. Also include a quick curl sanity check: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and a note that tokens must be exported in the same shell.

riley: I'll update the code snippets and the snippet test harness. Any troubleshooting pins we should add?

emma: Two tiny bullets: 1) If you get 401, confirm REDWOOD_TOKEN is exported in the shell running the command/container. 2) For quick demos, a CORS note: "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *" only for local demos; link to production CORS guidance.

docs-bot: Preview site created: https://deploy-preview-4350--docs.redwood.ai (preview live for 15m)

hugo: I'll validate the Cloud Run flow tomorrow and check logs to ensure Authorization headers are masked in traces.

riley: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4350 1 includes Dockerfile, curl examples, CLI one-liner, and the migration blurb. Assigning @emma and @hugo for review.

emma: Thanks 1 I'll review later today. If no blockers, merge before Friday's docs sync.
